Assessment Intelligence Operations Platform (AIOP)
Agentic AI-Powered Intelligence Platform for Secure Exams & Interviews
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
Revolutionize Assessment Integrity with AIOP
GenAI-driven cheating, deepfake impersonation, proxy test-taking syndicates,
and content leaks are no longer edge cases they are the new normal.
Traditional proctoring solutions are struggling to keep up.
Talview’s Assessment Intelligence Operations Platform (AIOP) changes the game.
Talview’s Assessment Intelligence Operations Platform (AIOP) is powered by a living ontology that dynamically maps relationships between candidates, exam sessions, behavioral events, and risk vectors, it imports best-in-class tactics from cybersecurity (real-time threat correlation), finance (predictive risk modeling), and defense (graph-based network analysis) straight into exam security.
